title: Marcos seeks protection for Filipino seafarers amid Middle East war

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said the Philippines is seeking the cooperation of other countries to protect Filipino seafarers as attacks on commercial vessels in conflict areas put their lives at risk. He said the country has been raising the presence of Filipino crew members with other countries to help keep them safe
